title: XDrip G5, Android 10, Oneplus 7 Pro phone
body: I have good connectivity during the day (with a few lost connections), But, during sleeping hours, my phone loses connection to my G5 every night. I have tried many settings without any success. I am guessing it is some type of deep sleep that is occurring with Android 10 because this did not happen on Android 9. I can always get it to reconnect by using "Restart Collector" in the "System Status" screen. I do have "Aggressive service restarts" enabled under "Less common settings" but it is not helping. I do have Xdrip marked as "Not Optimized" in Battery Optimization and have tried many of the suggestions I have seen here.  If anyone has foolproof workarounds, please post them. BTW, I am on OxygenOS 10.3.0

comments.body: I had a similar issue tonight with an OP6 (after using a nightly build that solved connection issues after i upgraded to Android 10). For me this was an unusual night since i did not plug in my phone to a charger overnight. does this occur when the phone is connected to power?

I rarely charge my phone at night. However, 2 nights ago, I had it plugged in all night and never lost a connection. So, it appears that something in Android 10 is affecting Xdrip when the phone is not plugged in and not in use for more than a certain amount of time. For me, it seems to be about 40 minutes after no use at night.

This might also be related to both of us being OP users. OP is known for its battery saving strictness in doze mode (or whatever its called these days). I am not sure anything can be done about this on Xdrip development side. I believe there's a wake-lock feature hidden somewhere in Xdrip settings. You can try toggling that and see if there's any improvement - although beware this might turn you into an overnight charger kind of person....
Have you disabled battery optimization of xDrip in Android settings?

I have disabled battery optimization for Xdrip but not other apps. It has
been working successfully for at least 8 months now. I am not sure whether
a phone update fix the issue or am App update fixed it. I try to stay
current by downloading new versions from github.

Craig Harding
